scope: Case → manual local review condition → confirmed save → Saved → exact-origin return or explicit current-record fallback.

existing_owners.reuse: Existing selection, URL, abort/token, focus and MDXAuth lifecycle.
PublicGenerationPublisher generation; queue/dossier/screen projection with explicit allowlist.
Existing NCT/event/change identity. Stable event identity is not source version.
Extend the incumbent module with strict result APIs; preserve existing compatibility exports.
ownerKeyFor(currentSubject()) only when subject resolved. No independent guest/account namespace.

current_source_limits: The inspected Bio client/API does not implement the Paper manual condition save/read/edit feature.
The existing condition URL parameter is a clinical filter; do not repurpose it.
Selected exact-row loss on URL roundtrip and missing-key same-NCT fallback were reproduced in isolated source fixtures, not observed in a live installed browser.
Current dossier lookup is NCT-based against the current projection; no historical-version argument was found.
_meta and generationKey expose clocks/counts but no shared immutable publication token.
The incumbent generation_id and _opaque_digest already bind Radar cursors. A pagination cursor is not a shared queue/dossier reference.
Sponsor mapping is ticker_only and company_identity_not_joined. Aster/Morrow are fictional design fixtures; production price conditions require a reviewed issuer/security + price/currency projection.
The public evidence block is allowlisted; internal snapshot/provenance/raw objects must not be copied into local storage.
Legacy readEnvelope swallows unavailable/corrupt reads into {}; Boolean writeOwnerSlot does not establish preserved valid data or matching readback.

proposed_source_binding.derive: Use existing _opaque_digest({generation_id: bundle_generation_id}) from the actual pointer-bound bundle read.
cover: Screen facets context where part of same selected publication
proposed_source_binding.validation: Nonempty incumbent generation_id; same NCT + exact row key + publication_ref for source-bound reopen. Preserve all three independently.
proposed_source_binding.meaning: Equality establishes the same published cut only. It is not authorization, issuer identity, source quality or historical retention.
proposed_source_binding.changed_or_missing: Retain saved definition and reference. Mark old reference unavailable; offer the explicit current record only if that exact NCT is authorized and available. Never substitute the first same-trial row silently.
proposed_source_binding.current_request_guard: Keep the existing abort/token controller. Capture the selected origin and subject; late A/B response cannot replace a different origin or owner.

proposed_local_record.schema_version: review_condition.v1 (proposed literal; confirm in incumbent consumer integration)
proposed_local_record.id: Locally generated record ID retained for edits; not a trial/issuer identity.

origin.instrument_ref: Required verified production instrument mapping for a price condition; fictional EX-A/EX-B do not supply this

definition.level_decimal: Positive finite decimal string after locale-aware input validation
definition.currency: Known bound instrument currency in production; explicit selection only in labelled fiction

proposed_local_record.created_at: Creation clock for local note; not source clock
proposed_local_record.updated_at: Last verified local edit clock; not evaluation time
absent_fields: No met/not_met status without an actual qualified evaluation owner
No raw provider snapshots, tokens or private source paths

proposed_storage_contract.read_rule: Only a successful getItem null or absent owner slot in a valid envelope is missing. Empty string, invalid JSON, nonobject envelope or unsupported/invalid owner payload is invalid.
proposed_storage_contract.owner_payload_validator: Bio consumer validates version, record IDs, definition, origin and record set; generic envelope parsing and owner selection remain incumbent ownerStorage responsibilities.
proposed_storage_contract.comparison_token: Exact raw envelope comparison token returned internally; not persisted identity or auth.
write_steps: Validate the JSON-safe proposed owner payload.
Strictly reread; refuse invalid/unavailable envelope or invalid current owner payload.
Compare expected raw envelope; if changed, return conflict before writing.
Preserve all other owner values while updating only the captured owner's slot.
Write once; immediately read and validate exact serialized envelope/payload.
Only matching readback returns written_verified. Attempted write without confirmation returns write_unverified; reconcile original storage before another attempt.
proposed_storage_contract.bundle: Build a version-pinned browser adapter from existing ownerStorage.ts and accountIdentity.ts, resolving the existing import alias. Serve it with Macro; do not copy helpers into biocatalyst.js.
proposed_storage_contract.identity: const subject=currentSubject(); const owner=subject ? ownerKeyFor(subject) : null;
proposed_storage_contract.account_change: Reuse MDXAuth.onChange; detach previous-owner displayed state and pending operation. Recheck subject before committing reads/writes. Do not delete or migrate prior data; no implicit guest fallback.
proposed_storage_contract.concurrency_limit: Read-compare-write-readback is not atomic CAS. Another tab may interleave or later overwrite. storage events prompt reconciliation, not locking.
proposed_storage_contract.persistence_limit: Verified immediate browser readback only; no disk-flush guarantee, indefinite retention, cross-device sync or cross-origin sharing.

interaction.create: Open the case's own form context. Morrow starts with no inherited Aster price. Disable save until required bound fields are valid.
interaction.invalid: Keep draft; inline error associated with field. Enter a price above 0. Focus invalid field on attempted submit.
interaction.save: Use one record ID for the attempt; no count/receipt until written_verified.
interaction.save_not_written: Keep draft and committed record. Offer retry only after classified not-written outcome and current context check.
interaction.save_unverified: Save not confirmed. Check saved conditions before retrying. Reconcile without creating another record.
interaction.edit: Modify same ID; original committed value retained until verified success. 39.60→41.00 is a fictional draft example.
interaction.cancel: Discard only draft; return to originating case or Saved row and restore focus/scroll.
interaction.saved_list: Valid loaded empty is 0; loading/unavailable/corrupt is unknown, displayed —. List count is the loaded owner's total.
interaction.quiet_day: Saved definitions remain available even if the case is absent from today's list.
interaction.return: Resolve exact saved origin through the existing page owner. Changed/absent reference keeps condition visible; explicit Open current record does not rewrite the saved reference.
interaction.no_monitoring: No future-close monitoring, notifications, automatic resurfacing, inferred return, trade order or alert activation.

responsive_and_motion.layout: 320px through desktop; flexible widths, wrapped action rows, minimum 44px controls. Preserve chart viewBox and series.
responsive_and_motion.scrolling: Height-constrained mobile shell with flex:1, min-height:0, overflow-y:auto on content; navigation outside scroll region.
responsive_and_motion.native_limitation: Paper normalized overflow-y:auto to overflow:clip. Full-content proof demonstrates content/reflow only; scroll gesture/runtime remains unverified.
responsive_and_motion.source_chart: Original W9-0 SVG exactly preserved; W7-0/W8-0 price header restyled by parent to prevent digit wrap.
responsive_and_motion.animation: 140–180ms opacity/small translation only for panel entry and confirmed feedback; no semantic state invention. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Playback unverified.
responsive_and_motion.accessibility: Semantic labels, native buttons/select/input, disabled state and aria-describedby errors. Polite confirmed-save feedback, accessible read errors, keyboard focus restoration. Existing focus/controller owner only.

build_order: Add safe public origin/publication binding through the existing API and review production instrument/price projection viability.
Add strict storage APIs in incumbent module, preserving compatibility; build shared browser adapter.
Integrate manual form and Saved view into existing Bio client/selection/auth lifecycle.
Prove actual installed consumer, keyboard/focus, narrow scrolling and storage/source races before release.
required_acceptance: Aster and Morrow forms keep distinct originating case and seed behavior.
Two rows with one NCT restore the exact selected event/change operation.
Same stable event ID with changed evidence date retains identity but differs by source reference.
Different generations with identical clocks/counts compare unequal using proposed publication_ref.
Same generation with changed operational clocks is not a new publication identity.
Absent saved exact row keeps definition; no first-same-NCT fallback.
Missing, empty, invalid JSON, invalid envelope, future payload version and unreadable storage remain distinct.
Quota/blocked write, failed readback and differing readback do not claim success.
Changed expected envelope is a conflict; preserve other owner slots.
Account changes during load/save cannot display or write under the previous owner.
Edit changes same ID only after verified save; cancel leaves committed record and count unchanged.
Duplicate-click/retry does not create duplicate record; unverified writes reconcile first.
Current-record fallback is explicit and does not claim historical restoration.
All four cards reachable with real mobile scroll; navigation remains visible; keyboard and enlarged text pass.
Production price conditions require verified instrument/currency binding and current source authority; fixture names/tickers cannot satisfy it.
